source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Each adjudicator marks and signs a score card per heat judged, in ink; a steward collects the cards for the Scrutineer; the organizer keeps the original score sheets for thirty days.

requirement: The text assumes paper score cards; the paper path (scorer entry, OD-12 transcription verification) is the best-supported alternative.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6E): judging-arrangement declaration and _compoc_blockers_judging_arrangement for the declared body. Not built.
interpretation_notes: No electronic ballot or scoring-tablet allowance exists in the text read (NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE; terms searched in design section 6E.1). Whether electronic marking can satisfy these items is an owner interpretation. NOT IMPLEMENTED (design only, PR-A section 6E): a BLOCKER to activating this body profile; no test; no compliance claimed. A declaration is a self-attestation, never a verification.
